summary: V2 iteration 1 backend testing — ALL 15/15 tests PASS. Verified: (1) /api/customer/google with invalid credential returns 401 'Invalid Google login' (not 500/404). (2) /api/customer/facebook with invalid access_token returns 401 'Facebook token is not valid'. (3) POST /api/offers accepts min_order_amount and echoes it; GET /api/offers?active_only=false includes it. (4) Coupon MIN1500 (min_order_amount=1550) rejects orders with total<1550 (400) and accepts when total>=min. (5) Reward stacking — coupon + reward whose reward_type=discount_fixed returns 400 with message mentioning coupon + Diamond/discount cannot be combined (server.py line ~2524). (6) GET /api/admin/reviews?status=all no longer crashes on feedback rows where order_id=None — returns array with is_feedback=true and order_id=''. (7) GET /api/track/{id} exposes prep_time_min (default 30), response_deadline_seconds (0..120 for pending), accepted_at, delivery_fee_overridden. (8) PUT /api/online-orders/{id}/operations updates prep_time_min=45 (reflected in /track), free_delivery=true sets delivery_fee=0 + overridden=true, delivery_fee_override=200 sets delivery_fee=200; returns 400 on delivered orders. (9) Happy paths: admin login, online order create -> accept -> track, create -> reject(out_of_stock) -> track all green.

tests_executed.name: TestRewardStacking::test_coupon_plus_discount_reward_rejected_400
tests_executed.details: End-to-end: registered TEST_stack_* customer, granted 5000 diamonds via /api/admin/loyalty/adjust, created discount_fixed reward of 50/100 diamonds, created stackable coupon (no min). Posting order with both coupon_code and reward_id returned 400 with the exact stacking-violation message.

critical_code_review_comments: Social login error paths are clean — invalid Google credential -> 401 via try/except around g_id_token.verify_oauth2_token (server.py ~2247-2252); invalid Facebook token -> 401 either via debug_token RequestError or explicit is_valid=false check (server.py ~2280-2289). No 500s slipped through. Good.

min_order_amount round-trip on offers is correctly stored as float (server.py 2083, 3216) and enforced before discount calc in create_online_order (server.py 2476-2478). Error message mentions the coupon code which is good for UX.

Reward stacking rule at server.py line 2523-2524 raises HTTPException(400) only for reward_type in ('discount_percent','discount_fixed') AND coupon_used set — confirmed via live test. Free-item rewards still stack with coupons (path skipped at line 2530), matching the spec.

/api/admin/reviews now guards ObjectId(None) (server.py 4192-4197) — defensive try/except + falsy check on oid. Output normalises order_id to '' for feedback rows, is_feedback=True surfaced. Good fix.

update_order_operations: 'delivered/cancelled/rejected' terminal-state guard at line 2925-2926 returns 400 with a sensible 'Cannot modify a {status} order' detail. Total is correctly recomputed when delivery_fee is overridden (subtotal - discount - reward_discount + new_fee). prep_time_min bounds 1..240 enforced.
response_deadline_seconds is a per-request derived value (server.py 4124-4138) using ORDER_RESPONSE_WINDOW_SEC env (default 120s); returns 0 for non-pending orders. Clean.
Minor: /api/offers returns 200 (not 201) on POST — inconsistent with REST convention but matches existing pattern across the codebase; not worth changing.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@restaurant.com / admin123. Customer fixtures: TEST_stack_<uuid>@x.com registered on the fly. Diamonds granted via /api/admin/loyalty/adjust. Coupons: pre-seeded MIN1500 (reused), TESTMIN<rand>, TESTSTK<rand>.
seed_data_creation: Session fixture forces 24/7 schedule (weekly_schedule dict keyed by day) and restores 10:00-23:00 on teardown. Tests create TEST_-prefixed offers, rewards, customers, feedback rows. No teardown deletes — left in place for next iteration's reuse (volume is tiny).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 added test_iteration6_v2.py covering all V2 backend changes. Note: /api/admin/online-settings expects weekly_schedule as a DICT (keyed by mon..sun), NOT a list — previous iterations sometimes passed a list which would 422. The session-scope ensure_24_7 fixture in this file is reusable. Social login endpoints cannot be tested with real tokens here (no Google/FB token issuer in the test env); we only verified the negative path. For the positive path, a manual UI test or a mocked g_id_token.verify_oauth2_token is needed. Frontend testing of social login UI, reward chip, response countdown, AdminOrders operations panel is pending per the request.
rca of the issue: n/a — all V2 endpoints behaved as specified. The earlier admin-reviews 500 (when order_id=None) is now fixed (verified). The coupon+reward stacking error path raises before any DB mutation, so no orphan reward or partial diamond deduction is possible.
